proven_findings.evidence: A null player record returns zero before any state mutation.
Bit 0x80 at player +0x7C8 rejects execution with You are too afraid! and returns handled.
The executor clears transient bits 0x0040 and 0x0400 at +0x6F4 and bit 0x0100 at +0x7C8 before lookup.
Only selectors 0x1F CAST and 0x6C INVOKE are accepted; all others return zero.
INVOKE requires class type 5 and CAST rejects type 5; missing power/spell lists and syntax failures are handled here.
The routine invokes 0x0046ABB4 over the action-specific input segment, rejects ambiguity counts above one, and requires one resolved candidate.
The matched 16-bit id is resolved through 0x00476F7D into the spell/power definition record.
0x0042029B validates the player against the resolved definition and emits You may not cast this spell. on failure.
0x004699FC parses the remaining input and returns a target-mode value plus resolved target/output fields; a retry path uses mask 0xF037 when the first classification is zero.
Mode 1 dispatches through 0x00444712 after target visibility/state checks.
Mode 4 is accepted as a self/no-external-target class and completes through the shared output path without calling the mode 1/2/8 dispatchers.
All other nonzero target classes are rejected with Why would you want to cast a spell on that?
Resolved temporary record state is released through 0x00476F22 and handled paths return one.
